name: Mercury
coolFacts: Orbital eccentricity ~0.206—the most elongated of all planets.
One Mercurian day lasts two Mercurian years.

name: Venus
coolFacts: Venus rotates backwards (retrograde) - the Sun rises in the west!
A day on Venus (243 Earth days) is longer than its year (224 Earth days).
Venus is the hottest planet in our solar system at 462°C, hotter than Mercury!
The atmospheric pressure on Venus is 90 times that of Earth - like being 900m underwater.

info.composition: Rocky planet with dense CO₂ atmosphere

name: Earth
coolFacts: Earth is the only known planet with life - home to over 8.7 million species!
Earth's magnetic field protects us from deadly solar radiation.
A year on Earth is actually 365.25 days long - that's why we have leap years!
Earth is the densest planet in our solar system at 5.51 g/cm³.

name: Mars

info.composition: Rocky planet with thin CO₂ atmosphere

coolFacts: Mars has the largest volcano in the solar system - Olympus Mons is 21km high!
A day on Mars is just 37 minutes longer than a day on Earth.
Mars has seasons like Earth due to its 25° axial tilt.
Mars appears red because of iron oxide (rust) on its surface.

name: Jupiter
coolFacts: Jupiter is so massive it could fit all other planets inside it!
Jupiter's Great Red Spot is a storm larger than Earth that has raged for 400+ years.
Jupiter acts as a 'cosmic vacuum cleaner' protecting inner planets from asteroids.
Jupiter has 97 known moons in the JPL satellites list.

info.composition: Gas giant (H₂, He) with extensive ring system
